policy.backend_policy: per-class embedding backend = highest calibration ROC-AUC; ties broken by average precision then backend name
policy.label_source: experimental selected-PDB active-site ligand context (geometry_features ligand_context.cofactor_families); empty means no local cofactor family observed in the selected structure, not a guaranteed biological apo assertion
policy.low_support_policy: classes with fewer than 5 calibration positives are flagged low_calibration_support and treated as report-only operating points
policy.split_source: assigned_embedding_split from the frozen mechanism-feature train/calibration split manifest; heldout rows are scored but their labels are never read
policy.threshold_policy: per-class operating threshold = max-F1 on the calibration split; precision-floor and recall-floor operating points are also reported for reference but the channel ships the max-F1 point
